series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a strong downward trend with weak seasonality, but high noise and unpredictability (spectral entropy >0.85). Concept drift is detected, and model rankings are unstable. Due to the high unpredictability, a robust baseline strategy with median aggregation is recommended to avoid overfitting to noisy patterns.

reasoning.robust_median: series_profile.noise.unpredictable=true → robust_median is recommended for high-noise, near-white-noise series (Goerg 2013)
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.11) → inverse_rmse_weights with shrinkage is preferred for unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013). Recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 aligns with this selection
reasoning.trimmed_mean_r0.10: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false → trimmed_mean is robust to unstable rankings (Genre et al. 2013). Recommended_knobs.trim_ratio=0.1 matches this candidate
